title: 37C3 -  Operation Triangulation: What You Get When Attack iPhones of Researchers
summary: A 37C3 talk by Kaspersky researchers on Operation Triangulation, a zero-click iPhone attack that targeted their own colleagues. They describe capturing every stage of the chain, four zero-days and a previously unknown spyware active for years.
why: HN recommends it as a gripping look at what nation-state attackers can do, used as the primary source in threads about iPhone security and Kaspersky.

quote.text: was a rollercoaster of a ride. If you have the time to watch it I highly recommend it!
